summary: Alpha Tau Medical Ltd. filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release about FDA clearance to complete enrollment in its REGAIN trial for recurrent glioblastoma. The filing discloses no special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change. The press release discusses clinical trial progress and FDA interactions. As a routine regulatory update on a clinical trial, this filing does not constitute a special situation.
